title: Nasruddin and the Stone Soup (The Village Feast)
summary: Stirring his iron pot of boiling river stones in the village square, Nasruddin welcomed contributions of barley, onions, and lamb bones from skeptical neighbors until a delicious f...
full_text:
Stirring his iron pot of boiling river stones in the village square, Nasruddin welcomed contributions of barley, onions, and lamb bones from skeptical neighbors until a delicious feast was served to all.

"The stone did nothing," smiled Nasruddin as the elders scraped their bowls, "except bring honest hearts together to share what God provided."
moral: A catalyst of good humor unlocks the generosity hidden in every human heart.
